The Life and Atchievements of Part I: 


Now the Truth. of the Story was this : There were two little Villages in 
that Corner of the Province, of which the one had neither Barber nor Cob-

thatin the leſſer Village there were two Perſons, the one that wanted the

defend thy ſelf, or yield methat which is' ſo juſtly my Due. The Barber,
